chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to place the walking stick in front of him when he prayed.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet place in front of him during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) using a walking stick (*anazah*) as a *sutrah* to demarcate the prayer space and prevent others from passing directly in front. In Shia jurisprudence, this practice underscores the importance of maintaining a defined area during prayer, serving as a primary textual basis for the ruling that a *sutrah* is recommended (*mustahabb*) or obligatory depending on the school of thought, to preserve the sanctity and focus of the worshipper.
